stories.title: Saudi Arabia signs energy cooperation deals with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt

en.title: Saudi Arabia signs energy cooperation deals with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister signed three cooperation agreements with counterparts from Kuwait, Qatar, and Egypt covering electricity, renewable energy, oil, gas, petrochemicals, and energy storage, with provisions for technology exchange and joint projects.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s air defenses intercept Houthi missile in Khamis Mushayt

en.title: Saudi Arabia's air defenses intercept Houthi missile in Khamis Mushayt
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Yemen's Houthi militia toward Khamis Mushayt in southwestern Saudi Arabia early Monday, with civil defense declaring the danger had passed after an emergency alert.

stories.title: Pakistani resident killed, 11 injured in Sunday’s attack on Riyadh airport

en.title: Pakistani resident killed, 11 injured in Sunday's attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: One Pakistani resident was killed and 11 others injured in an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Sunday, with the injured receiving hospital treatment and authorities assessing damage.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia signs pacts for expanding energy cooperation with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt

en.title: Saudi Arabia signs pacts for expanding energy cooperation with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister signed three memoranda of understanding with Kuwait, Qatar, and Egypt to expand cooperation in electricity, renewable energy, power grid interconnection, and related energy fields.

stories.title: Saudi, Iranian FMs Discuss Regional Tensions as UK, Syria Condemn Houthi Attack

en.title: Saudi, Iranian FMs Discuss Regional Tensions as UK, Syria Condemn Houthi Attack
en.summary: Saudi and Iranian foreign ministers discussed regional tensions. The UK and Syria condemned a Houthi attack.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, and Turkiye condemn Houthi attacks on Kingdom

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, and Turkiye condemn Houthi attacks on Kingdom
en.summary: Four countries issued a joint statement condemning Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that caused casualties and infrastructure damage. They characterized the attacks as violations of international law and Saudi sovereignty.

stories.title: Saudi, Iranian foreign ministers discuss regional tensions after airport attack

en.title: Saudi, Iranian foreign ministers discuss regional tensions after airport attack
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister addressed regional tensions following Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport that resulted in 12 deaths, with support from Jordan and condemnation from the EU.

stories.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport

en.title: Global condemnation mounts over deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport
en.summary: Multiple countries and international organizations condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 civilians, with the UAE describing it as a violation of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty.

stories.title: 12 Killed, 309 Injured in Attack on Riyadh Airport; Coalition Vows Response

en.title: 12 Killed, 309 Injured in Attack on Riyadh Airport; Coalition Vows Response
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh Airport resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries. A coalition has pledged to respond to the incident.

stories.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 others, reaffirming Pakistan's commitment to Saudi Arabia's security and territorial integrity.

stories.title: UK Defense Minister: Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport 'Dangerous Escalation' and 'Contemptible'

en.title: UK Defense Minister: Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport 'Dangerous Escalation' and 'Contemptible'
en.summary: The UK Defense Minister characterized a Houthi attack on Riyadh Airport as a dangerous escalation and used strong language to condemn the incident.

stories.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio strongly condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people, including an American citizen, and stated that the United States supports Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia builds additional pipelines as alternative routes to Hormuz: Minister

en.title: Saudi Arabia builds additional pipelines as alternative routes to Hormuz: Minister
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister stated the kingdom is constructing additional pipelines to bypass the Strait of Hormuz while maintaining commitments to global energy markets despite current challenges.

en.title: Tadawul's weekly market cap rises SAR 89.2B
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Tadawul stock exchange market capitalization increased by 0.98% to approximately SAR 9.21 trillion in the week ending October 8, with foreign investors holding 4.62% of total market capital.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Oct. 7
en.summary: Major ownership changes occurred on the Tadawul stock exchange on October 7.

en.title: ANB Capital issues Q3 2026 earnings forecasts
en.summary: ANB Capital released third-quarter 2026 earnings estimates for Saudi-listed companies, projecting Al Rajhi Bank's net profit to increase 12.1% year-on-year to SAR 7.1 billion and Saudi National Bank's profit to grow 3.5% to SAR 6.7 billion.

stories.title: ‎Saudi air defense destroys missile near King Khalid International Airport

en.title: Saudi air defense destroys missile near King Khalid International Airport
en.summary: Saudi air defense systems intercepted a cruise missile near King Khalid International Airport, though an unidentified projectile struck Terminal 4, causing a fire that authorities are responding to.
